notifications.incorrect_password: Failed to connect to {ssid}: Incorrect password

refreshinterval.label: Refresh Interval (Seconds)
refreshinterval.description: How often the background service updates network state.

color.label: Widget Icon Color
color.description: Custom color token or hex for the status bar widget icon.

text_color.label: Widget Text Color
text_color.description: Custom color token (e.g. primary, on_surface) or hex for the widget text.

hotspot_ssid.label: Hotspot Name / SSID
hotspot_ssid.description: Network name broadcasted by your Wi-Fi hotspot.

hotspot_password.label: Hotspot Password
hotspot_password.description: Password required for devices to connect (minimum 8 characters).

hotspot_max_connections.label: Max Hotspot Connections
hotspot_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected devices.

custom_dns_1.label: Custom DNS Slot 1
custom_dns_1.description: Format: Name = IP1 IP2 (e.g. NextDNS = 45.90.28.0 45.90.30.0). Only appears in DNS menu when filled.

custom_dns_2.label: Custom DNS Slot 2
custom_dns_2.description: Format: Name = IP1 IP2 (e.g. Mullvad = 194.242.2.4). Only appears in DNS menu when filled.

custom_dns_3.label: Custom DNS Slot 3
custom_dns_3.description: Format: Name = IP1 IP2 (e.g. ControlD = 76.76.2.0). Only appears in DNS menu when filled.

widget_display_mode.label: Widget Display Mode
widget_display_mode.description: Choose what information is displayed on the status bar widget.

widget_indicator_dots.label: Widget Status Dots
widget_indicator_dots.description: Choose which status indicator dots appear on the bar widget.

widget_right_click.label: Widget Right-Click Action
widget_right_click.description: Action performed when right-clicking the bar widget.
